manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual physical pp225 and 476-478 describes BETWEEN demands, transfer backorders when source items are unavailable, split execution on later availability, and priority above ordinary demand. pp681-683 and 717 describe native item-position STSZ/STOHA; installed dictionary defines ItemTransfer and StockAllocation columns. This contract tests the behavior directly rather than assuming every manual claim is exact under the fixed model.
controlled_design: Accepted I02.var03 has depot initial stock1, h4 IN1, and h6 BETWEEN1. Move the BETWEEN schedule to h2 in a frozen control, before the h4 IN, leaving all other business rows fixed. The matched child changes only AIR_BASIC DEPOT-01 StockAllocation.STSIZ from1 to0 plus description. At h2 the control should have source stock1 and child source stock0. Both arms keep BETWEEN TFQTY1/TFDT0, h4 IN1, item tracking, half-hour ITEM collection, seed1, support and repair routes, and 36h horizon. Parent→control changes transfer schedule and description; control→child changes initial stock and description; each comparison has 30 unchanged tables.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: With one initially available depot LRU, the h2 BETWEEN request should execute immediately with no transfer backorder. Physical ID and station-ledger timing must be observed.
pre_run_hypotheses.zero_source: With zero initial depot stock, the h2 BETWEEN should leave a one-unit transfer backorder rather than inventing a physical item. The h4 IN may satisfy that backorder, but exact event order, physical identity, nominal stock and later ordinary demand remain conditional.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, hidden initial stock, h2 physical transfer in zero arm, no source-bound report, unchanged zero/control behavior, or source/closure mismatch blocks a positive zero-source claim. Nominal target timing and aggregate metrics are observations, not preregistered success criteria.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run audit of parent/control/child source and exact deltas, manual/dictionary pins, and guarded native runners
Two serial session-0 SSH native runs under host-wide mutex preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 22 populated-table roundtrip per arm, zero converter errors, valid nonempty native output and sealed raw files
Direct physical item/transfer-backorder ledger and native 72-bin depot/base ItemResults STSZ/STOHA/NBO from both sealed SXOs
Author and independent read-only replays, final staged audit and bounded publication
limits: Positive evidence can cover one zero-source h2 BETWEEN before a scheduled h4 IN versus a matched one-unit control at one seed. It cannot establish arbitrary zero-stock timing, multi-unit split, general priority, reorder/procurement, positive delay, or standalone BETWEEN without later IN.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
